documentation.content: A backend request or earningsnerd-pregenerate job logged a summary stream exception or timeout. Inspect the filing-scoped log and related request/job execution. A pre-generation job can exit successfully after consuming a terminal error event, so the failed-execution metric alone is insufficient. This catches logged failures, not every handled fallback. See docs/OPERATIONS.md.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: ((resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="earningsnerd-backend") OR (resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="earningsnerd-pregenerate")) AND ((severity>=ERROR AND (jsonPayload.message:"Error in streaming summary" OR textPayload:"Error in streaming summary")) OR (severity>=WARNING AND (jsonPayload.message:"Pipeline timeout after" OR textPayload:"Pipeline timeout after")))
